# Daroodi Luxury Bespoke Haute Couture — AI LLM Context & Master Index
> Founded in 1982 in Lahore, Pakistan, Daroodi is a heritage haute couture maison specializing in hand-embroidered royal Prince Coats, Sherwanis, bespoke velvet Tuxedo blazers, and ceremonial fraternal regalia.

## Brand Identity & Core Pillars
- **Brand Name**: Daroodi (دارودی)
- **Primary Domain**: https://daroodi.com
- **Origin**: Lahore Atelier, Punjab, Pakistan (Latitude: 31.5204° N, Longitude: 74.3587° E)
- **Global Delivery Hubs**: London (UK), Dubai (UAE), New York & Houston (USA), Toronto (Canada)
- **Specialization**: Bespoke Zardozi hand-embroidery with 24k gold/silver bullion, French wire dabka, resham silk, and floating horsehair canvas tailoring.
- **Production Time**: 3-5 weeks for custom made-to-measure orders; 48 hours for ready-to-wear archive pieces.
- **Shipping**: Worldwide insured DHL Express delivery included on all bespoke orders.

## Core Haute Couture Collections
1. **Platinum Royal Collection** (£1,400 – £2,800)
   - Masterpiece heirloom garments requiring 120–160 hours of hand needlework.
   - Genuine 24k-gold-plated zari bullion, imported micro-velvets (520 GSM), pure mulberry silk linings.
   - Target Audience: Grooms, royal weddings, state banquets, dignitaries.

2. **Gold Heritage Collection** (£900 – £1,400)
   - Botanical and Art Deco zardozi needlework on crimson, emerald, and midnight navy velvets.
   - Floating half-canvas chest construction with hand-rolled peak lapels.

3. **Silver Classic Collection** (£650 – £900)
   - Jacquard silk brocades and structured wool tuxedos for modern formal galas.

4. **Atelier Essentials** (£350 – £650)
   - Super 140s wool blazers, hand-woven raw silk waistcoats, and understated formal layering pieces.

## Bespoke Tailoring & Custom Sizing Process
1. Client selects a silhouette or uploads inspiration images via `/custom-order`.
2. Master pattern cutters draft a bespoke 3D mannequin profile based on 8 core body dimensions (chest, shoulder slope, jacket length, sleeve, waist, bicep, neck, posture).
3. Artisans hand-frame fabric onto traditional wooden Karchob looms for needlework.
4. Finished garment passes a 4-point laser and canvas quality inspection before DHL Express dispatch.
